Package com.viam.service.navigation.v1

Class NavigationServiceGrpc.NavigationServiceStub

java.lang.Object
io.grpc.stub.AbstractStub<NavigationServiceGrpc.NavigationServiceStub>
io.grpc.stub.AbstractAsyncStub<NavigationServiceGrpc.NavigationServiceStub>
com.viam.service.navigation.v1.NavigationServiceGrpc.NavigationServiceStub
Enclosing class:
NavigationServiceGrpc
public static final class NavigationServiceGrpc.NavigationServiceStub extends io.grpc.stub.AbstractAsyncStub<NavigationServiceGrpc.NavigationServiceStub>
A stub to allow clients to do asynchronous rpc calls to service NavigationService. 
 A NavigationService declares the gRPC contract for a Navigation service.
 Each service instance is bound to exactly one controllable base and one map
 type (local SLAM or GPS). Apps save named locations, routes, and zones, then
 navigate with plan-then-drive or direct go-to motion.

      public void addLocation(Navigation.AddLocationRequest request, io.grpc.stub.StreamObserver<Navigation.AddLocationResponse> responseObserver)

 omitted, the robot's current position from GetPosition is saved.

      public void navigateToLocation(Navigation.NavigateToLocationRequest request, io.grpc.stub.StreamObserver<Navigation.NavigateToLocationResponse> responseObserver)
       NavigateToLocation plans an obstacle-aware path to a saved location and

    • navigateToPoint

      public void navigateToPoint(Navigation.NavigateToPointRequest request, io.grpc.stub.StreamObserver<Navigation.NavigateToPointResponse> responseObserver)
       NavigateToPoint plans an obstacle-aware path to a Position and starts
 driving it. Returns once the goal is accepted; track progress with
 GetNavigationStatus. On a Pose, theta defaults to 0 if omitted.

    • navigateRoute

      public void navigateRoute(Navigation.NavigateRouteRequest request, io.grpc.stub.StreamObserver<Navigation.NavigateRouteResponse> responseObserver)
       NavigateRoute drives a route one waypoint at a time using the
 obstacle-aware planner. Provide either route_name (a saved route) or
 waypoints (an inline list).

    • planToPoint

      public void planToPoint(Navigation.PlanToPointRequest request, io.grpc.stub.StreamObserver<Navigation.PlanToPointResponse> responseObserver)
       PlanToPoint computes a path from the robot (or a given start) to a
 Position without moving. Pass a feasible result to ExecutePlan to drive it.
 Raises an error if no path exists.

    • planToLocation

      public void planToLocation(Navigation.PlanToLocationRequest request, io.grpc.stub.StreamObserver<Navigation.PlanToLocationResponse> responseObserver)
       PlanToLocation computes a path to a saved location without moving. Accepts
 the same optional start as PlanToPoint. Raises an error if no path exists.

    • executePlan

      public void executePlan(Navigation.ExecutePlanRequest request, io.grpc.stub.StreamObserver<Navigation.ExecutePlanResponse> responseObserver)
       ExecutePlan drives a Plan (typically from PlanToPoint or PlanToLocation).
 While navigating, the active path is available on GetNavigationStatus. Rejected if
 the path is empty.

    • goToLocation

      public void goToLocation(Navigation.GoToLocationRequest request, io.grpc.stub.StreamObserver<Navigation.GoToLocationResponse> responseObserver)
       GoToLocation drives directly to a saved location with a closed-loop
 controller, without full path planning. Intended for short hops and
 docking. With wait false, returns immediately while navigating.

    • goToPoint

      public void goToPoint(Navigation.GoToPointRequest request, io.grpc.stub.StreamObserver<Navigation.GoToPointResponse> responseObserver)
       GoToPoint drives directly to a Position with a closed-loop controller,
 without full path planning. Intended for short hops and docking. With wait
 false, returns immediately while navigating.

    • suspend

      public void suspend(Navigation.SuspendRequest request, io.grpc.stub.StreamObserver<Navigation.SuspendResponse> responseObserver)
       Suspend stops motion but remembers the current goal, including the current
 waypoint and loop setting for routes. A suspended goal must be canceled
 before a new one starts.
